say:1:1122315001:1.text: Oh lookie here, a new customer!

say:1:1122315001:1.male: Oh lookie here, a new customer!
say:1:1122315001:1.female: Oh lookie here, a new customer!

say:2:1122315002:1.text: What are you after? You wanna track someone down? Figure out Quicksand Claw gossip? Or details on the Buckthorn Caravan's robbery?

say:3:1122315003:1.text: Anything goes, as long as the price is right!
say:3:1122315003:1.source_cn: 只要价格合适，一切都好说！

choice_prompt:4:1122315003.text: Anything goes, as long as the price is right!
choice_prompt:4:1122315003.source_cn: 只要价格合适，一切都好说！

say:5:1122315004:1.text: That's the hottest gossip right now!
say:5:1122315004:1.source_cn: 有，当然有！这可是最近最抢手的消息！

say:6:1122315005:1.text: Word is, those bandits were originally part of the Quicksand Claws. When Ferranc disappeared, they split off on their own.
say:6:1122315005:1.source_cn: 听说啊，那伙盗匪以前都是流沙之爪。弗兰克没了之后，他们...

say:7:1122315006:1.text: That's why they used a secret passage and set up their base in the <style="highlight">northern highlands</style>, rather than near the Claw Camp.
say:7:1122315006:1.source_cn: 也正是因为如此，他们没敢把营地设在流沙之爪主营附近，而...

say:9:1122315007:1.text: W-whoa! Magister, did he just say...?
say:9:1122315007:1.male: W-whoa! Magister, did he just say...?
say:9:1122315007:1.female: W-whoa! Magister, did he just say...?

say:11:1122315008:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! That was a lot of info at once, let's sort through it carefully.
say:11:1122315008:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! That was a lot of info at once, let's sort through it carefully.
say:11:1122315008:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! That was a lot of info at once, let's sort through it carefully.

say:13:1122315009:1.text: What, you guys worried I'm lying?
say:13:1122315009:1.source_cn: 怎么，担心我说的是假话？
say:13:1122315009:1.male: What, you guys worried I'm lying?
say:13:1122315009:1.female: What, you guys worried I'm lying?

say:14:1122315010:1.text: Don't worry, ask around the camp. My intel is always spot-on!
say:14:1122315010:1.source_cn: 放心吧，你在这营地里打听打听，我舍尔曼的情报从来都是最...
say:14:1122315010:1.male: Don't worry, ask around the camp. My intel is always spot-on!
say:14:1122315010:1.female: Don't worry, ask around the camp. My intel is always spot-on!

say:15:1122315017:1.text: Anyways, you got any more questions?
say:15:1122315017:1.source_cn: 除了这些，你还有什么想问的吗？我一定知无不言。

choice:16:0:1.text: Have you met any of those bandits?
choice:16:0:1.male: Have you met any of those bandits?
choice:16:0:1.female: Have you met any of those bandits?

choice:16:1:2.source_cn: 盗匪是不是收买了一些人？

choice:16:2:3.text: But the bandits' camp is nearby.
choice:16:2:3.source_cn: 盗匪的营地就在附近吧？
choice:16:2:3.male: But the bandits' camp is nearby.
choice:16:2:3.female: But the bandits' camp is nearby.

choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 抢劫红沙棘的盗匪有线索吗？

say:18:1122315011:1.source_cn: 流沙之爪营地附近……这怎么会呢！

say:19:1122315012:1.text: I've got many sources, and none of them mentioned bandits nearby. In fact, I heard the opposite.
say:19:1122315012:1.source_cn: 我舍尔曼有那么多渠道，没有任何一个人告诉我，那附近有盗...

say:20:1122315013:1.text: According to my sources, the bandits were originally with the Quicksand Claws when Ferranc was in power, but then they split up and hightailed it far away, hiding in the <style="highlight">northern highlands</style>.
say:20:1122315013:1.source_cn: 我听说的甚至刚好相反。那群盗匪是从流沙之爪独立出去的，...

say:22:1122315014:1.text: So they must be in the northern area of the Crimson Highlands!
say:22:1122315014:1.source_cn: 主……主人！他说的是北边的深红高原……！
say:22:1122315014:1.male: So they must be in the northern area of the Crimson Highlands!
say:22:1122315014:1.female: So they must be in the northern area of the Crimson Highlands!

say:24:1122315015:1.text: Is that different from what you heard? Then you were probably lied to.
say:24:1122315015:1.source_cn: 怎么，和你们得到的消息不同吗？那你大约是被骗了。
say:24:1122315015:1.male: Is that different from what you heard? Then you were probably lied to.
say:24:1122315015:1.female: Is that different from what you heard? Then you were probably lied to.

say:25:1122315016:1.text: If the person who fed those lies to you took your coin, you can probably still catch up to them.
say:25:1122315016:1.source_cn: 要是告诉你这消息的人收了钱，现在去找他算账也还来得及。
say:25:1122315016:1.male: If the person who fed those lies to you took your coin, you can probably still catch up to them.
